from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Represents one judgment document parsed from the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) specified in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all judgment documents found in the collection."""
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument] = Field(description="List of judgment documents parsed")
